contracts.requirement: Runtime attachment requires both explicit enablement and an explicit socket path; no discovery or environment fallback occurs. Requested attachment with a non-loopback HTTP listener fails startup. Unattached serving retains its existing listener behavior.
contracts.covered: Explicit flag/path pairing, wildcard rejection, explicit IPv4 acceptance, Host/Origin checks.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Original non-loopback rejection is superseded by accepted ADR0006; never demand its obsolete test outcome. Environment/discovery exclusions also require source audit.

contracts.requirement: Introduce the smallest private runtime broker boundary needed by this behavior, independently owned per live inspection session. Its interface exposes capability metadata and bounded observations for validated scopes; producer protocol, identity, retry, cache and resource details stay private. Any necessary ownership prefactor happens first within this slice, with disk behavior unchanged.
contracts.covered: Private adapter/broker session ownership and unchanged HTTP disk-session response.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Smallest interface/no ownership prefactor are design judgements, not a numerical test; no complete architecture-negative proof claimed.

contracts.requirement: Use private real/simulated adapter and injected clock/scheduling seams without a new runtime dependency. Simulations are test fixtures, never a production trust bypass. Until ticket 02 provides verified attachment, no observations or active/verified capability are fabricated.
contracts.covered: Injected scheduler works for configured/disabled brokers; simulated implementation is test-only.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Historical until-ticket02 sequencing is not a current lack of real attachment requirement; no dependency graph audit inferred from this test.

contracts.requirement: GET /api/v1/runtime/capabilities returns Cache-Control: no-store and a sanitized runtime envelope. Reserve disabled, connecting, active, stale, unavailable, refused and incompatible as capability states; pause, expiry and observation coverage are separate dimensions. Missing sockets mean unavailable, not proof of the producer's parameter setting.
contracts.covered: Disabled/unavailable sanitized envelopes, no-store, stable producer-error reasons.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: State-space and dimension presentation are supplemented by lifecycle/UI rows below; missing socket never proves parameter value.

contracts.requirement: Capability requests have four independent admission slots, no queue and a one-second deadline. Runtime admission and errors cannot consume the ordinary inspection resource queue or change inspection outcomes or diagnostics.
contracts.covered: Four admitted requests, fifth429, no blocked disk session, deadline release and virtual boundaries.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Not a throughput/latency benchmark or exhaustive scheduler proof.

contracts.requirement: The browser identifies the source as CUBRID page-buffer observation and presents disabled/unavailable states with accessible text. Paths, UID/GID/PID, raw OS errors, pointers, private structures and application bytes are absent from HTTP and UI disclosures.
contracts.covered: Accessible source label and disabled/unavailable states; selected observation rendering and sanitized HTTP.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Specific checked envelopes cannot establish absence of all future disclosures; keep producer07 sanitization evidence and source review.

contracts.requirement: Runtime capability publication never advances snapshot generations, inspection revisions or cursors, or wakes disk-watch clients. The inspection graph, TUI, exports and standalone executable contract remain unchanged.
contracts.covered: Capability calls leave the compared disk-session response unchanged.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: No comprehensive negative proof of every graph/TUI/export/watch path from two HTTP tests; retain ADR0004/0006 and full distribution checks.

contracts.requirement: Tests exercise actual configuration parsing, the real HTTP boundary and rendered capability presentation, including invalid listener/configuration combinations, no-store, sanitization, independent admission below/at/above capacity and unaffected disk inspection without CUBRID installed.
contracts.covered: Actual configuration parsing, HTTP admission/no-store and embedded browser capability without CUBRID.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Listener expectation follows revised ADR0006. External engine and full release evidence are separate.

contracts.requirement: Document explicit opt-in and loopback/SSH use using the accepted domain vocabulary. This ticket adds neither public authentication/TLS nor engine discovery, resident-page inspection, AOUT, event history or engine implementation.
contracts.covered: Operator docs and current accepted transport boundary are present.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Documentation/source evidence, not an executed SSH or engine installation test.

contracts.requirement: Vendor an exact revision/hash-pinned producer-owned corpus and verify it offline. Resolve semantic conflicts explicitly with the producer owner rather than adding browser exceptions. CUBRID producer implementation remains external.
contracts.covered: Offline corpus pin and all enumerated decoder exchanges are checked.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Producer execution and semantic-mapping authority remain in integration-01/08; no browser exception or engine implementation is introduced here.

contracts.requirement: Authenticate Linux AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM peers with SO_PEERCRED and exact effective-UID equality, with no root/group exception. Check private-directory and socket ownership before trusting observations. Verify database-creation identity and the complete permanent-volume set of volid, volume-creation identity, device and inode, excluding temporary volumes. Names or paths alone and subset identity proof are insufficient; oversized identity proof refuses attachment.
contracts.covered: Actual credential isolation, unsafe endpoint mode rejection, six identity mutations and corpus refusal cases.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Private-directory ownership, oversized identity and temporary-volume exclusion require their source/native/corpus-specific evidence; do not inflate one named case into all boundary permutations.

contracts.requirement: Bind observations to the producer's unpredictable incarnation and negotiated protocol. The handshake supplies shared/private LRU topology counts. Identity mismatch produces refused with stable identity-mismatch; refusal or protocol incompatibility clears evidence and requires explicit retry. Sanitize verification, protocol, database fingerprint and abbreviated incarnation; never disclose raw peer identity or socket details.
evidence: frontend:refusal clears evidence and stops automatic retry until explicit refresh
frontend-effects:protocol-incompatible observation responses stop retry without exposing decoder details
contracts.covered: Identity/incarnation refusals, evidence revocation and explicit retry reach broker/state/browser.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Unpredictable producer incarnation generation and coherent native topology are producer evidence; formatting/sanitization scope stays explicit.

contracts.requirement: Decode versioned JSON-lines with snake_case fields and lowercase semantic enums. Ignore unknown optional same-major fields within limits; reject missing mandatory identity, framing or count fields. Consume semantic page kind rather than native ordinals, including branch-dependent mappings, and never expose packed flags.
contracts.covered: Pinned corpus decoding, additive numbers, duplicate members and depth refusal.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Native ordinal mapping/coherent sampling require producer07 tests; decoder acceptance cannot prove native implementation.

contracts.requirement: Present VPID, semantic page kind, latch mode none/read/write/flush, waiter presence, fix count, dirty, flushing, async_flush_requested, to_vacuum, page LSA and oldest-unflush LSA. Preserve the coherent latch-word tuple and coherent LRU flags tuple without claiming record-wide or pool-wide atomicity. Present LRU zone lru1/lru2/lru3/void/invalid, list kind shared/private/none/invalid and exact kind-local index or null when not applicable; indices are incarnation-local.
evidence: frontend:absent optional evidence remains unknown while nullable LSA is known empty
contracts.covered: Selected detail and exact membership/null semantics, absent optional fields.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Browser cases assert selected labels/variants; they do not independently prove every native flag or coherent latch/LRU tuple. See integration08 native evidence.

contracts.requirement: Validate scan sequence/start header, records and explicit end/count/truncation footer, including raw counts before deduplication and increasing incarnation-local sequence. Sequence is not an event sequence; use capture intervals, not invented per-page timestamps. Duplicate VPIDs are ambiguous/unknown, never last-write-wins.
contracts.covered: Footer-before-publication, corpus sequence/count cases and duplicate ambiguity across rotating captures.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Producer event/atomicity exclusions remain semantic documentation; consumer checks do not prove source capture timing implementation.

contracts.requirement: An evaluated requested Page omitted from a complete scan is observed not-resident, not guaranteed currently absent. Partial omissions and unevaluated Pages are unknown. Valid truncated scans publish partial evidence; malformed streams, missing footers or assembly overflow discard the whole unfinished assembly and retain only prior usable, unexpired evidence with its original age. Never synthesize a footer or merge scans into apparent completeness.
contracts.covered: Complete omission versus partial unknown, duplicates, footer rejection, retained original-age data and UI expiry.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: No cross-capture union; setup-specific tests do not prove all malformed-stream variants beyond the named corpus.

contracts.requirement: Enforce binary-byte limits before unbounded allocation: 65,536 records, 64 MiB framed scan, 4 KiB record/control frame including newline, 64 KiB handshake and nesting depth 16; connect plus handshake within 500 ms and whole scan exchange including drain/footer within two seconds. Parse incrementally without buffering the whole wire stream.
contracts.covered: Frame/raw-count/framed-scan/depth boundaries and actual stalled handshake/scan deadlines.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Deadlines are exercised I/O bounds, not hard-real-time scheduling or release performance evidence.

contracts.requirement: Account at most 48 MiB per decoded scan and 128 MiB total broker memory, including allocated capacities, indexes, duplicate tracking, parser buffers, retained/in-flight captures, response-held older captures and serialization. No spill or history; aggregate admission can stop below an individual object limit. Replacement does not uncharge still-referenced memory. RSS is a separate measurement.
contracts.covered: Shared allocation admission and retained/inflight/response ownership accounting, actual decoder aggregate refusal.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: RSS is separately measured and currently fails; source reservations/record-size assertions supplement exact48MiB cap, not a peak-memory test.

contracts.requirement: POST /api/v1/runtime/page-buffer/observe returns Cache-Control: no-store and echoes accepted ordered VPIDs and scope/request epoch, normalized states, capture identity/interval, limitations, producer completeness and separate requested/evaluated counts. Enforce at most 512 VPIDs, 64 KiB request body and 1 MiB response, eight admitted requests including waiters with no extra queue, a 2.5-second deadline and HTTP 429 overload. A requested scope never changes the producer's bulk-scan cap.
contracts.covered: Ordered scopes,512 pages,64KiB request,1MiB response, eight/ninth admission, real HTTP and body-inclusive deadline.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Producer bulk traversal cap is separately covered; named test executions are not per-boundary execution counts.

contracts.requirement: Maintain one connection, one latest capture and at most one in-flight scan per session from the first working attachment, with a 500 ms scan-start floor. This slice supports explicit selected-Page refresh; automated lifecycle and viewport scheduling follow in tickets 03 and 04 without temporarily removing safety limits.
contracts.covered: Shared cached capture, concurrent coalescing and independent500ms scan-start floor.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: One-connection ownership source audit supplements observed request counts; no fairness guarantee.

contracts.requirement: From the first observation, enforce monotonic conservative age from broker scan-request start through serialization, adding browser full HTTP round trip and elapsed time. Cache reads never renew capture age; source wall time is display-only. Fresh means known upper age within two caller intervals; uncertain evidence is not fresh. Evict browser and broker evidence after 30 seconds even while paused. Revoke incompatible late adoption on route, scope, generation, overlay, pause or incarnation changes, checking echoed scope/epoch independently of cancellation.
evidence: frontend:full round trip contributes to conservative age and paused evidence expires at 30 seconds
frontend:a backwards browser wall clock cannot extend observation freshness
frontend:selected-page freshness uses two 500 ms caller intervals
frontend:reusing a capture cannot lower age and suspension cannot revive it from cache
frontend:echoed epoch and ordered VPIDs independently reject incompatible responses
frontend:pause revokes late adoption independently of request cancellation
frontend-effects:browser expiry has its own cancellable deadline instead of waiting for the periodic age tick
contracts.covered: Roundtrip/elapsed age, expiry while paused, clock changes, cache age monotonicity and epoch/scope revocation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Serialization age implementation is source-backed; finite tests do not establish arbitrary scheduler delays.

contracts.requirement: Selected-Page detail and an initial residency mark distinguish observed residency, observed nonresidency, partial/ambiguous unknown, unavailable and expired evidence with non-color labels. Storage facts remain intact; nothing claims page-image correspondence, commit visibility, durability or event causality.
contracts.covered: Non-color residency/partial/duplicate/unavailable/expired distinctions and retained disk navigation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Named human interpretation/accessibility review is still missing; no image correspondence or transaction claim.

contracts.requirement: Test the production decoder using scripted socket chunking/coalescing, EOF, stalls, malformed framing, additive fields, count/sequence/identity errors, duplicate ambiguity and valid partial scans. Exercise the real HTTP and browser boundaries, plus deterministic highest-interface broker tests and actual I/O timeout checks. Cover below/at/above applicable caps, including retained plus in-flight plus response-held memory; report named executed cases and nonzero counts. Peer-credential isolation requires a suitable environment, not a silent skip.
contracts.covered: Concrete decoder/socket/HTTP/browser tests with nonzero execution records, actual timeout and allocation tests.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Use corpus case manifest for subcases and cross-repo evidence for native scope; no skipped credential run is relabelled pass.

contracts.requirement: Add default selected-Page polling at 500 ms through the shared broker. Respect the independent 500 ms broker scan-start floor rather than confusing it with the producer's 100 ms floor. Reuse a capture only within the requesting caller's cadence or join refresh demand; never accumulate missed ticks or historical captures.
evidence: frontend:enabled selected-page observations poll without explicit retry and never queue missed ticks
contracts.covered: Default selected polling, no missed-tick backlog, caller cadence and broker scan floor.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Producer100ms floor remains a separate native boundary; no cadence performance acceptance.

contracts.requirement: Transient retry uses nominal delays 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds, then eight seconds, with +/-20% jitter and an actual maximum of 9.6 seconds. Reset after a valid scan. Connectivity status and retained, aged evidence remain separate.
evidence: frontend:transient failures retain original evidence age, back off, and reset only after a valid scan
frontend-effects:observation retry timers apply bounded jitter and dispatch one epoch-bound demand
contracts.covered: Nominal0.5/1/2/4/8-second backoff, retained age and valid-scan reset. The effect test asserts6400/8000/9600ms at random0/0.5/1 for the8000ms nominal delay.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Numerical jitter/epoch dispatch and nominal progression are separate named tests; timer scheduling precision on a busy host is not measured.

contracts.requirement: Interpret version-unsupported, busy, rate-limited and incarnation-changed through stable normalized capability/reason behavior. Parameter-off is only defensive compatibility; socket absence does not prove that setting. Peer/identity refusal and protocol incompatibility clear evidence and stop automatic retry until an explicit operator retry.
evidence: frontend:refusal clears evidence and stops automatic retry until explicit refresh
frontend-effects:protocol-incompatible observation responses stop retry without exposing decoder details
contracts.covered: Normalized error reasons and refusal/incompatibility stop until explicit retry.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Parameter-off is defensive protocol behavior; no inference from absent socket.

contracts.requirement: Hidden tabs send no runtime requests. Paused tabs stop adoption of disk generations and runtime observations and check capability metadata only every five seconds; these checks cause neither scans nor adoption. Another tab's newer capture is only an availability indication while paused.
evidence: frontend:pause schedules only metadata; hidden revokes requests; resume demands a post-request scan
frontend:paused metadata is availability only and restart clears evidence even without resume
frontend-effects:queued runtime effects send no requests after visibility or adoption authority is revoked
contracts.covered: Hidden silence, five-second paused metadata, newer-capture offers without adoption/scans.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Browser visibility is emulated in scripted coverage; real-engine tab lifecycle remains integration09.

contracts.requirement: Resume requires a scan started after resume, respecting the shared scan-start floor; an older cache hit or pre-resume in-flight scan cannot fulfill it. Route, scope, overlay and pause changes revoke incompatible late responses even if cancellation races.
evidence: frontend:pause revokes late adoption independently of request cancellation
frontend:failed resume retains its barrier and cannot adopt another tab's old cached capture
frontend-effects:queued runtime effects send no requests after visibility or adoption authority is revoked
contracts.covered: Late response revocation, failed-resume barrier, pre-resume inflight rejection and cancellation isolation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: No claim of fairness for arbitrary client counts or hard timing.

contracts.requirement: Producer incarnation changes clear retained evidence and adoption authority even while paused. Disk-generation changes prevent incompatible generation-scoped late adoption but do not alone erase retained state for the same proven database/volume identity; matching generations/VPIDs never imply image correspondence.
evidence: frontend:paused metadata is availability only and restart clears evidence even without resume
frontend:same-page generation replacement revokes late adoption but retains state-only evidence
frontend:a new-incarnation stale fallback clears old evidence before preserving any failure state
contracts.covered: Incarnation reset and matching-identity generation retention with incompatible late-adoption rejection.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Generation/VPID equality remains insufficient for page-image correspondence.

contracts.requirement: Maintain conservative monotonic age across cache reuse and failed requests. Freshness is relative to each caller's expected cadence and requires known age within two intervals. Wall-clock steps never renew age; uncertain elapsed time after suspension revokes freshness. Enforce 30-second broker/browser eviction while paused and display an expired explanation rather than a history.
evidence: frontend:full round trip contributes to conservative age and paused evidence expires at 30 seconds
frontend:a backwards browser wall clock cannot extend observation freshness
frontend:selected-page freshness uses two 500 ms caller intervals
frontend:reusing a capture cannot lower age and suspension cannot revive it from cache
frontend-effects:browser expiry has its own cancellable deadline instead of waiting for the periodic age tick
contracts.covered: Paused30s expiry, caller freshness and broker/browser wall-clock/suspension invalidation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Virtual-clock semantics and source accounting are not clock-change release workload measurements.

contracts.requirement: Preserve all authentication, framing, memory, timeout and HTTP limits from ticket 02. Polling or reconnecting cannot bypass them, change inspection outcomes/diagnostics or disturb ordinary disk navigation.
contracts.covered: Existing bounded admission/deadline/memory tests plus lifecycle navigation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Finite combined tests cannot alone prove all combinations of reconnect with each cap; retain functional integration audit.

contracts.requirement: Demonstrate the complete flow with deterministic clock/scheduler broker and browser-effect tests, real HTTP coverage and Chromium/Firefox lifecycle scenarios: retries, refusal/explicit retry, differing cadences, hidden/pause/resume, another-tab newer offers, late responses, clock steps/suspension, expiry and restart while paused. Keep actual socket timeout checks separate from virtual-time tests.
evidence: frontend:paused connectivity failure remains visible and a restarted broker's lower revision cannot hide incarnation change
frontend-effects:observation retry timers apply bounded jitter and dispatch one epoch-bound demand
contracts.covered: Named deterministic state/broker tests, actual I/O deadline and both-browser lifecycle families.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Scripted socket and intercepted browser faults are labelled; native shipped-server evidence remains integration09.

contracts.requirement: Extend normalized requests and browser presentation to selected-first ordered scopes, followed by nearest visible-sector pages and physical order. At the 512-VPID limit, rotate the non-selected remainder explicitly and show reduced admission/rotation; do not silently exclude the selected Page or claim full viewport evaluation.
evidence: frontend:viewport demand preserves selected priority, rotates overflow, and revokes late batches
frontend:visible-page cadence is two seconds with explicit below, at and above-cap coverage
contracts.covered: Selected priority, bounded512-page scopes, overflow rotation and scrolling revocation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: ADR0008 changes future Volume scope to64 sectors/no timer rotation; current shipped512-page evidence does not validate that unimplemented expansion.

contracts.requirement: Use a two-second visible-page cadence and a 500 ms selected-page cadence, with one connection, latest-scan cache and in-flight refresh per attached session. Cache eligibility is per caller's own cadence, and scan starts remain at least 500 ms apart. No per-tab scan, connection, missed-tick backlog or history is introduced.
evidence: frontend:visible-page cadence is two seconds with explicit below, at and above-cap coverage
contracts.covered: Two-second visible cadence versus500ms selected cadence with shared scans and coalescing.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Future64-sector behavior and real32-tab performance remain separate.

contracts.requirement: Return requested/evaluated counts and accepted scope/epoch per waiter independently of producer completeness. Fully evaluated browser scope does not imply a complete producer scan; partial or unevaluated omissions remain unknown. Duplicate ambiguity and complete-scan omission semantics survive batching unchanged.
evidence: frontend:every batch row and scope coverage is validated independently of producer completeness
contracts.covered: Independent per-row/scope counts, producer completeness, duplicates and partial omissions.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: A fully evaluated scope is not a complete pool scan; no union across captures.

contracts.requirement: Coalesce admitted requests without replacing their scope authority. One caller cancelling cannot cancel another's demand; stop unnecessary work when the last observer leaves. No claim of starvation-free service for arbitrarily many clients is made.
contracts.covered: Other callers survive cancellation; last observer cancels unfinished work; eight waiters share capture.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: No starvation-free guarantee or arbitrarily many-client proof.

contracts.requirement: Enforce eight observation slots including waiters, no queue, 2.5-second deadline and HTTP 429 overload; capabilities retain four independent slots and a one-second deadline. Keep body/response caps at 64 KiB/1 MiB and runtime admission independent of disk requests.
contracts.covered: Separate capability/observation admission,HTTP429, body/response limits and body-inclusive deadline.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Cached HTTP25ms and concurrent disk5% performance gates remain unexecuted.

contracts.requirement: Under concurrent demand, remain within 48 MiB per decoded scan and 128 MiB total accounted broker allocation, including retained, in-flight, old response-held captures and serialization. Prove that object caps cannot collectively exceed total admission and that no whole-wire buffering or spill is introduced.
contracts.covered: Aggregate admission/ownership survives decoder and response/capture retention.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: RSS limit is independent and current density fails; no whole-wire/no-spill source-wide negative audit inferred.

contracts.requirement: Show coverage/overload and useful available observations at both Volume and Sector scopes using existing semantic presentation; the full visual encoding follows in ticket 05. Existing selected-Page age, expiry and late-response safeguards apply throughout.
contracts.covered: Volume/Sector coverage, overload and unknown/expired presentation through normalized HTTP.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Manual accessibility and dedicated-host visual/input measurements remain open.

contracts.requirement: Verify via scripted producer plus real HTTP and browser tests: simultaneous tabs, different cadences, viewport churn, selected priority, overflow rotation, independently validated waiters, cancellation isolation, no-demand shutdown, overload and unaffected concurrent disk requests. Exercise below/at/above scope, response, admission and memory caps, including retained/in-flight/response peaks.
evidence: frontend:viewport demand preserves selected priority, rotates overflow, and revokes late batches
contracts.covered: Named shared-demand, cadence, cancellation, caps, viewport and both-browser scenarios.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Real32-tab resource matrix and per-combination limits are not proven by small deterministic cases.

contracts.requirement: Test valid truncated rotating captures, exact-cap complete captures and stable-pool rotation progress. Never union partial scans into completeness or absence evidence. Consumer tests recognize the producer contract of at most one visit per slot and rotation beyond the visited span; engine traversal implementation remains owned by CBRD-27398.
contracts.covered: Rotating truncated captures preserve partial/duplicate semantics; full-count consumer boundary.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: At-most-once slot visits and next-start beyond visited span are producer traversal evidence under integration07/08, not inferred from consumer simulation.

contracts.requirement: This slice can be developed and verified independently of ticket 03 using explicit requests and controlled visibility/cadence fixtures. It must use the same shared broker scheduling contract so later lifecycle integration preserves all admission and adoption invariants.
contracts.covered: Controlled explicit broker requests independently exercise the shared scheduling contract.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Historical development independence is a design property, not a new runtime gate; lifecycle behavior now coexists.

contracts.requirement: Preserve existing storage colors beneath cyan residency outlines, amber dirty corners and static magenta flushing edges. Use the accepted visual prototype as design evidence, not production code or proof of performance.
contracts.covered: State/LRU mode composition, shared circle and occupancy preservation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Exact visual/color interpretation still needs manual review and CSS authority; prototype is not performance evidence.

contracts.requirement: Provide an alternative LRU-topology color mode rather than mixing LRU colors into storage allocation colors. Consume normalized shared/private topology counts and coherent zone/list-kind/kind-local-index observations; show exact indices in selected-Page detail, including none/invalid/null meanings and incarnation-local scope.
contracts.covered: Keyboard LRU switch, storage-color restoration, list counts and exact/null/invalid membership labels.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Producer coherent native tuples/topology need integration evidence; no atomic pool view.

contracts.requirement: Derive only observed per-list summaries from validated capture records and explicitly label them partial when the source is partial. Do not present native counters/quotas or combine captures into an apparent pool snapshot.
contracts.covered: Per-batch list-count label, partial unknowns and incarnation invalidation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Counts are not native totals/quotas; detailed source arithmetic audit supplements semantic assertions.

contracts.requirement: Keep latch/waiter/fix and other detailed state in selected-Page detail rather than dense-grid animation. Retain semantic page kind, dirty/flushing/async-flush-requested/to-vacuum and log-position detail without inventing transition start/end, duration, counts, cause or durability.
contracts.covered: Selected detail has semantic latch/log-position and exact list membership; limitations visible.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Not every flag has an independent browser value assertion; native semantics and no-event-history exclusion remain producer/source/docs evidence.

contracts.requirement: At both Volume and Sector scales, distinguish capability, freshness, pause, expiry and observation coverage independently. Source-unavailable, unevaluated/partial unknown, duplicate ambiguity and observed nonresidency must not share a misleading absence mark. Prefer no overlay to fabricated evidence.
contracts.covered: Partial/duplicate/absence/expired/refused distinctions, no misleading source-failure absence marks.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Human perception and real workloads remain manual/performance gates.

contracts.requirement: Provide keyboard-operable controls, stable compatible focus and non-color glyphs/text/accessible names for runtime states. Respect reduced motion and high contrast; polling and age ticks do not create repeated announcements. Initial semantics must be accessible before the final gate in ticket 06.
contracts.covered: Focus, keyboard navigation, quiet live regions, forced-color/reduced-motion emulation and glyph tests.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Named manual screen-reader/visual review is still missing; browser assertions cannot substitute for it.

contracts.requirement: Test the complete normalized HTTP-to-render path with real frontend state/effects and Chromium/Firefox semantic assertions at both scales. Cover state-mark/LRU switching, exact membership, partial summaries, identity changes, unknowns and expired/unavailable evidence; use a small screenshot set only as supporting visual evidence.
evidence: frontend:every batch row and scope coverage is validated independently of producer completeness
contracts.covered: Normalized scripted socket/HTTP/state-to-browser journey at both scales and invalidation scenarios.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: Synthetic and intercepted cases supplement real-producer integration; screenshots are supporting artifacts only.

contracts.requirement: Runtime rendering never mutates inspection facts, revisions, generations, diagnostics, outcomes, export content or TUI behavior. No AOUT history, protected resident-page inspection, image correspondence or unrelated kernel-cache/attribute-selection feature is introduced.
contracts.covered: Disk-session/navigation preservation and documented presentation-only separation.
contracts.remaining_or_limit: No exhaustive negative proof of every graph/export/TUI path; separate distribution/source review remains part of delivery.
